title: Abbr Hint
description: Stops readers guessing at jargon (TAT, SLA, kWh) by making each term a dotted, tappable and keyboard-focusable hint instead of a hover-only <abbr title>, spelling it out inline on first use, reading the expansion to screen readers without opening anything, and flagging abbreviations the glossary doesn't cover, with a portalled hint that is never clipped by a scrolling card or table and flips to stay on screen.
stops: Readers guess at jargon like TAT
